0.comment: Shinobi Chronicle UI — GitHub Gallery filename contract
0.content: When the optional Shinobi Chronicle UI is active, use the existing speech tags but the [CHAR] image slot MUST be a bare filename that exists in the repository Gallery, never a direct URL or Catbox code. Format: [CHAR|filename.png|Name|#color|rank|village]. Example only if that file exists: [CHAR|sasuke.png|Sasuke Uchiha|#6f71a8|Jōnin|Konohagakure]. NPC remains [NPC|Name|#color|role]. Dialogue remains [SAY|#color|text]. Monologue remains [THINK|Name|#color|text]. Never invent a Gallery filename that has not been registered.
